summary: Punch it Gym is a Muay Thai camp in Lamai, Koh Samui with group and private training, on-site accommodation, a cafe and a fitness centre.

facts.label: Group class
facts.value: 400 THB for one class per day

facts.label: Private lesson
facts.value: 1,000 THB for a one-hour private lesson

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.quote: IN-HOUSE ACCOMMODATION AND MUAY THAI PACKAGES FROM ONE SOURCE

facts.label: Recognition

facts.quote: AWARDED BY THE SPORTS AUTHORITY OF THAILAND AS A PROFESSIONAL MUAY THAI GYM

facts.label: Levels
facts.value: Beginners, advanced students and active fighters
facts.quote: TRAINING FOR BEGINNERS, ADVANCED STUDENTS AND ACTIVE FIGHTERS

facts.label: Location
facts.quote: Located in Lamai on one of the most beautiful islands in South Thailand
